summary: AWAKE AS (org. no. 922 750 742) is a private limited company (AS) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2019-05-14. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 73.110 (Reklamebyråvirksomhet). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 662 793 and net income was -NOK 39 755. CEO: Marte Alstad Hansen.
